column1: # Plugin (subsdk6) offsets of the load instructions that read main text words the IPS changes (a hook site), found by tools/emu.py
# with EMU_LAZY=1 (main stays clean, each site word is written when its hook is installed). build.py routes each through a thunk that
# reads the shadow instead. Union of two runs: the shipped config, and tweaks.ini on (enabled, every option, both show-off times 1500). Offsets only,
# no game bytes. Columns: offset, times read in the run that found it
